pages.text: Gnomes live in deserts, badlands, and hot savannas. They are small, wear turbans, and carry compasses.$(br2)Their chief virtue is navigation — never doubt a gnome's sense of direction.
Gnomes are natural couriers. If a gnome delivers something to you, $(italic)accept it$(). They probably walked days to reach you.$(br2)Never refuse a gnomish delivery.
